summary_md: **IvesFeng ([@FengIves](https://x.com/FengIves/status/2116079988097028257))** flags Anthropic's **formal-math** repo, where Claude found and Lean-formalized a deterministic 2^{o(n)} algorithm for 3-SAT that would refute ETH, cautioning that it is purely asymptotic and readers should check the README rather than read it as P=NP ([anthropics/formal-math](https://github.com/anthropics/formal-math)).
relevance: A notable claim of AI-driven, machine-checked mathematical discovery.
